description: YouTube discovery via the Data API v3 (search/read/list, API key only, no OAuth2 writes yet -- #227).

youtube_search.description: Search videos matching a query (search.list, type=video). Costs 100 quota units per call, the most expensive endpoint in this API.

youtube_list.description: List a channel's uploads (playlistItems.list on its uploads playlist). CHANNEL accepts a channel ID, an @handle, a bare name tried as a handle, or a youtube.com/channel/... or youtube.com/@... URL.

youtube_read.description: Read video title + channel + stats + top N inline comments (with comment IDs). Accepts a bare video ID or a watch/youtu.be/shorts/embed URL. A video with comments disabled degrades to a note rather than failing.
